summary.en: The thread sound: the `thread` bed in D major following a tension curve over the chain (intro, build, a half-time merge, breaks under the ink and the card, the drop on the sheet, the outro on the name) and a sound on every picture event.
summary.zh: thread 的声音：D 大调的 thread 音乐床，沿整条链的张力曲线走（引子、铺垫、合并处半速、水墨和卡片下的停顿、样片表上落拍、名字上的尾声），每个画面事件都有一个声音。

fits: Reels of video and motion tools; films with many small landings.
notFor: Films with voice-over; dark or tense subjects.

intent.en: Sound like the chain looks: every landing heard, the energy rising to the sheet and resolving on the name.
intent.zh: 听起来就像这条链的样子：每次落定都听得到，能量升到样片表，在名字上落定。

content.en: The arc roles and the cues of the scenes.
content.zh: 骨架的角色和各场景的提示点。

fits.zh: 视频与动效工具的作品集；有很多小落定的片子。

notFor.zh: 有旁白的片子；阴暗或紧张的主题。

en: A film that opens on a hit overshoots the true-peak ceiling after AAC encoding: keep the 60 ms fade-in.
zh: 开头就是重音的片子，AAC 编码后真峰值会超：保留 60 毫秒淡入。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
